family_prior: 14-3-3 proteins are obligate homodimers (PMID 7603574); all 14-3-3 gamma:peptide crystals listed in public_structures contain the dimer, one peptide per groove
implication: A1B1 is the scored unit; a modelling variant A2B2 (dimer, a peptide in each groove) mimics the native environment and may stabilise the groove geometry. Inputs A1B1 and A2B2 already exist under /gpfs/deepfold/casp/casp17/targets/H1388/inputs/
